aws_region.description: AWS region to deploy resources; it must be the region the declared zones belong to

validation.error_message: aws_region must be a region identifier such as us-east-1.
network_cidr must be a valid IPv4 CIDR.

subnet_private_a_zone.description: Availability zone the private-a subnet lives in; a volume can only attach to a machine in its own zone

subnet_private_a_cidr.description: CIDR block for the private-a subnet, carved out of the network

validation.error_message: subnet_private_a_cidr must be a valid IPv4 CIDR.

subnet_public_a_zone.description: Availability zone the public-a subnet lives in; a volume can only attach to a machine in its own zone

subnet_public_a_cidr.description: CIDR block for the public-a subnet, carved out of the network

validation.error_message: subnet_public_a_cidr must be a valid IPv4 CIDR.

group_persistent_machine_type.description: Provider machine type for each node in the persistent group

group_persistent_root_volume_type.description: Root volume type for each persistent node

group_ephemeral_machine_type.description: Provider machine type for each node in the ephemeral group

group_ephemeral_root_volume_type.description: Root volume type for each ephemeral node
